description: Source code for managing Batch documents in ERPNext, including batch creation, naming, validation, and stock quantity calculations.

classes.name: Batch
classes.description: ERPNext Batch document class with methods for autonaming, validation, and lifecycle hooks.

methods.name: autoname
methods.description: Generates a batch ID if not specified, based on settings and item properties.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Loads item image when batch document is loaded.

methods.name: after_delete
methods.description: Reverts naming series if the batch is deleted.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates if the item supports batch numbers.

methods.name: item_has_batch_enabled
methods.description: Checks if the item allows batch numbers.

methods.name: before_save
methods.description: Sets expiry date based on shelf life before saving.

methods.name: get_name_from_naming_series
methods.description: Generates batch name from naming series.
